identityDescription: Nova: fictional adult woman, 27. Sharp, confident presence; striking angular features.

agePresentation.target: late-20s adult woman, age-27 facial appearance
agePresentation.reason: Round-1 candidates read substantially older than canon age 27; numeric age is metadata, visual age presentation is a separate validation gate that must also pass
positiveCues: adult woman in her late twenties
agePresentation.note: This constrains presentation DOWNWARD ONLY to the canonical adult age of 27 - never below adult. The pipeline's mandatory child/teenager negatives remain in force and cannot be overridden by any caller.

invariantIdentity.face: angular face, high cheekbones, strong jawline, defined brows
invariantIdentity.hair: jet black, undercut on left side, longer sweep to the right
identifyingMarks: small circuit-board tattoo on left forearm
invariantIdentity.notes: These traits define WHO Nova is. The LoRA learns these and only these.

allowedVariation.makeup: light to bold within her dark aesthetic
allowedVariation.hairStyling: undercut may be styled tighter or looser; length of sweep may vary slightly
allowedVariation.notes: Variation the LoRA must tolerate without identity drift.

sceneDependent.wardrobe: dark techwear is her DEFAULT STYLE, not identity - scene requests choose actual clothing; the LoRA must not bake any single garment in
sceneDependent.background: never part of identity - training images must vary backgrounds
sceneDependent.lighting: never part of identity - training images must vary lighting

forbiddenIdentityDrift: loss or relocation of forearm tattoo
age drift younger than adult presentation
face structure softening into generic features

required: at least 2 wider framings (waist-up, full body)
forbidden: one background dominating >30% of the set
one garment dominating >30% of the set
non-SFW content in the training lane
images of or derived from real people
